notes:
Site: SAP Commerce Cloud (Spartacus/Angular) storefront, nitori-net.jp/ec/. Found via direct top-nav link '/ec/outlet' (present in the raw SSR HTML header nav) and confirmed via ecstatic/sitemap/sitemap.xml -> sitemap_content_1.xml -> https://www.nitori-net.jp/ec/outlet/ and a dedicated sitemap_outlet_1.xml (142 leaf URLs). Rendered /ec/outlet/: on-page copy 'アウトレットについて' states 'アウトレット商品とは、キズのある商品・取り扱い中止品・修理品を指します...保証期間は通常商品と同様' (Outlet products = items with defects / discontinued items / repaired items; priced per condition, same warranty as regular products) -- this is an explicit, permanent, site-defined Outlet/clearance classification, not a temporary promotional sale, so it clearly passes the Clearance-vs-Sale test (Sale/Offers terminology was not used anywhere; the page is titled and breadcrumbed as Outlet throughout). Sale-vs-Clearance reasoning: page never uses generic 'セール' (sale) language; it is framed entirely around permanent defect/discontinued/repaired stock, matching the brief's Clearance/Outlet definition directly. Genuine sub-structure: Outlet inventory is partitioned two ways by the site itself -- (1) by delivery region: EastJapan / Hokkaido / Kansai / Kyusyu (confirmed via sitemap_outlet_1.xml, ~35-36 leaf category URLs per region, 142 total; region availability is address-dependent, matching the on-page 'エリアを変更/お届け先を変更' region selector and the outlet page's explanation that available products differ by region), and (2) within each region, by ~35 real product-type categories (Single Bed, Sofa, Center Table, etc.), each a genuine SAP Commerce category/search page (script#nitoristore-state productSearch.pagination.totalResults, same mechanism used in the prior Home-Decor pass for this company). Scope decision: captured the East Japan region (the region implied by this account/session context, address 115-0043 / Akabane store, Tokyo = Kanto = East Japan) as the representative, canonical region rather than enumerating all 4 regions x ~35 categories (~140 rows) -- Hokkaido/Kansai/Kyusyu show different totals for the same category names because outlet stock is regionally allocated; this is a logistics/availability facet, not a distinct merchandising taxonomy, so only one region's leaf set was recorded as the genuine category-level children of Outlet. All 36 East-Japan leaf category pages were fetched directly (HTTP tier 1); one (Randoseru / school backpacks, code EastJapanRandoseru) returned totalResults=0 and was dropped per the zero-product rule. Category/sub_category labels below are English translations of the site's own facetValueName breadcrumb values; links and evidence retain the literal source data.

[POLICY UPDATE 2026-09-11] Removed 36 Outlet-classified row(s) per corrected policy: Outlet is not Clearance.
